title: agentopt scorecard
description: One measurement of the agent against its goals (.agentopt/reports/*.json). Every case carries a continuous score in [0,1] (deterministic checks are 0 or 1; the judge grades continuously); the case score is the mean over its runs, and the scorecard score is the mean over cases. status is a threshold on the case score, kept for display.

score.description: Mean continuous case score, in percent. Null if nothing was measurable.

behavior_quality.description: Mean case behavior score, in percent, over VALID executions only — the quality dimension, separated from reliability. (New; optional for back-compat with pre-separation scorecards.)

execution_reliability.description: Valid executions / attempted executions, aggregate. A flaky provider lowers this, NOT behavior_quality.

evaluation_coverage.description: Successfully measured checks / configured checks. A check that could not run (check_error) lowers coverage, not quality.

judge_coverage.description: Judged quality checks / configured quality checks — a subtype of evaluation_coverage. Judge unavailability lowers this, never appearing as a quality gain.

total_tokens.description: Agent tokens self-reported across all runs (the cost signal, black-box-friendly). Null when no run reported usage.

total_latency_ms.description: Summed model+tool time across all runs (from the trace). 0/null in black-box mode. A lexicographic tiebreaker: prefer cheaper/faster among otherwise-equal candidates.

source.description: The GOALS.md text this case was compiled from.

score.description: Mean per-run score in [0,1] — the continuous reward this case contributes.

attempted_runs.description: Total agent executions attempted — the RELIABILITY denominator and resample budget. `runs` counts only GRADED executions, so with a flaky judge runs < attempted_runs. Null on pre-separation cards (fall back to runs).

valid_runs.description: Runs that executed validly (outcome == 'valid') — the RELIABILITY numerator; <= attempted_runs. Null on pre-separation cases.

valid_graded_runs.description: Runs that executed validly AND received a grade — the behavior_score merge weight; <= valid_runs. Null on pre-separation cards (fall back to valid_runs).

executions.description: The agent executions this case was graded against, BY IDENTITY, so suite reliability is computed over UNIQUE executions (cases sharing a run — e.g. null-input checks on one surface — must not double-count it). Null on pre-separation/hand-built cards.

id.description: Execution id, unique within a scorecard and distinct across separate eval runs (resamples).

valid.description: Whether the agent process executed validly.

behavior_score.description: Mean output quality over this case's VALID runs. Null when valid_runs == 0 (the case is unmeasurable for quality — a reliability signal, handled by the reliability gate, never counted as quality 0).

failure_breakdown.description: Counts per run-level failure category (see run-evidence.schema.json run_outcome). Sums to runs - valid_runs.

check_status.description: Whether this case's check could be evaluated at all — feeds coverage, distinct from pass/fail. 'judge_unavailable'/'check_error' are coverage misses, not quality failures.

passes_on_any_run.description: Aggregation policy: when true, one satisfying run suffices so the case score is the MAX over runs; otherwise runs are AVERAGED. Recorded so accumulated resampling merges preserve the engine's aggregation.
